meta.name: test-error-states
meta.description: Force the states a happy-path run never reaches (a failing API, an empty list, a slow request, a timeout, an expired session, a toast that auto-dismisses) and check the UI actually handles them. Use when error handling was written but never run, when a loading or empty state needs verifying, when a bug only happens on a slow connection, or when a timer, poll, debounce or retry needs testing without sleeping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟接口失败、超时、空数据、会话过期等异常,验证界面真的扛得住
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果错误处理代码写好了却从没跑过,想确认页面在异常下不乱
copy.tagline_en: Force failing APIs, timeouts and empty data, then check the UI really holds up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if error handling was written but never exercised and you want proof the UI copes

howto.what: 在运行中的应用里强制制造失败接口、空列表、超时、过期会话等异常状态,再检查界面是否真的处理了:错误有没有显示、重试是否可用、状态是否一致、控制台有无未捕获报错。
howto.when: 当错误处理写完却从未运行、需要验证加载或空状态、或要测定时器、轮询等定时逻辑而不 sleep 时触发。

say.text: 把 /api/deploys 模拟成 500,看看部署列表的错误提示长什么样
say.note: 拦截该请求并在界面上触发错误状态

say.text: 让搜索接口返回空数组,检查空状态页面是否正常显示
say.note: 用空 200 响应验证空状态

say.text: 冻结时钟并推进 5 秒,验证 toast 是否自动消失
say.note: 用受控时钟代替真实等待

howto.what_en: Runs your app and forces the states a normal run never hits - failing API, empty list, timeout, expired session - then checks the UI shows the error, stays usable, and logs nothing uncaught.
howto.when_en: Use when error handling was written but never run, a loading or empty state needs verifying, or a timer, poll, debounce or retry needs testing without sleeping.

say_en.text: Mock /api/deploys as a 500 and show me what the deploy list error looks like
say_en.note: Intercepts that request and triggers the error UI

say_en.text: Return an empty array from the search API and check the empty state renders
say_en.note: Verifies the empty state with an empty 200

say_en.text: Freeze the clock, advance 5 seconds, and verify the toast auto-dismisses
say_en.note: Uses a controlled clock instead of sleeping
